text: {"id":"explore","title":"Average Memory Usage by Region","viz":"table","description":"Computes the average memory utilization percentage per region from system_metrics, grouped by region and sorted from highest to lowest.","format":"percent","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT region, avg(mem_pct) AS avg_mem_pct FROM system_metrics GROUP BY region ORDER BY avg_mem_pct DESC"},"options":{"columns":[{"name":"region","label":"Region"},{"name":"avg_mem_pct","label":"Avg Memory","format":"percent","decimals":1,"align":"right"}],"sort":{"column":"avg_mem_pct","order":"desc"}},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":12,"h":4}}
